text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are concerned about your infant's bilious vomiting, inability to pass meconium, and abdominal distension. To determine the cause, how old is the baby in hours, and have they passed any stool at all?

text: 2-day-old male infant. The infant was born via a home birth without complications. The mother reports that the infant has had bilious vomiting and has not been able to pass meconium since birth. She also notes that the infant's abdomen appears distended.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung Disease (Congenital Aganglionic Megacolon)

The infant's failure to pass meconium within 48 hours, combined with bilious vomiting and distension, strongly suggests a distal intestinal obstruction. REQUEST TEST: Rectal_Absence_of_Stool; REQUEST TEST: Anorectal_Manometry; REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Xray_supine.
